title: Keeping Your Distance
goal: Report a claim without saying that it is true, and recognise the news conditional.
grammar: Reporting from a distance: según, al parecer, supuestamente, presunto

items: I can report a claim without saying it is true, with según, al parecer, supuestamente and presunto.
I can recognise the news conditional (El ministro habría dicho…).
I can use the new words for reporting from a distance.
